message: Hey friends! I’ve been thinking about how a sudden blackout can be an opportunity to rediscover some good old-fashioned fun. Instead of reaching for our phones or turning on the TV, we can enjoy board games, storytelling, or even a candlelit dinner. I found a great resource that offers some practical tips for preparing for power outages while keeping it light and breezy. What’s your favorite low-tech activity to enjoy when the lights go out?
